segments.text: Vel is a desktop Gmail client built with Rust and Tori. Email sync to local SQLite. No servers, full offline access, instant startup, low memory, keyboard
first with superhuman style shortcuts and a command pallet. AI integration.
Claude GPT Gemini for thread summaries, smart replies and inbox search, all cached locally. Smart inbox with autocategorization, snooze, schedule,
send, undo, send, and follow-up reminders.
